query:
MATCH p = ALL TRAIL (src:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(dst:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Independent generation from the q_trail public prompt and current query skill references. ALL TRAIL permits repeated nodes, forbids repeated edges, and retains parallel-edge path multiplicity. nodes() plus transform() preserves path order and returns business id properties. No DISTINCT, list sorting, USE, or writes. Documentation and checklist reviewed; not executed against a database.
